messages:
maria: Heads-up — reranker-v2 rolled to staging and we're seeing golden set rank inversions on ~0.6% of queries. Not a full regression but enough to fail some checks. :eyes:
ken: Which golden subset? longform-summarization or convo-rank?
maria: longform+faq anchors. Example seed id: seed-9f3b2 — old rank 1, new rank 5.
lucy: Could be embedding drift from tokenizer change in reranker pipeline.
aj: Is the reranker using new embed model or new tokenization? We only changed quantization in candidate model.
maria: Reranker uses q4b encoder+int8 rerank head. Tokenization changed to unified-tokenizer v2 in that release.
ken: If tokenizer changed, embed fingerprints won't match — kvcache prefixes misalign.
lucy: Repro snippet: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO" https://staging.redwood/api/rerank -d '{"seed":"seed-9f3b2","candidates": [...]}'
```
aj: I'll run a golden-only eval and push results to /tmp/regen-rerank.json
aj: assigning ticket RW-8342 and will tag @lucy for tokenizer diffs. plan: 1) rerun golden eval, 2) check embed provenance hashes, 3) if token mismatch create mini-golden patch and label ~100 examples.
maria: sounds good — can you also add a quick quality histogram? we want to know severity bucket.
ops-bot: deploy bot: reranker-v2 rollback started on staging at 6132109950 :wrench:
ken: If rollback reduces inversion, that's telling. If not, we investigate candidate generation.
lucy: I'll prepare a small label batch for the suspected 120 seeds and ping @labeling to triage.
aj: will post results by EOD.
maria: thanks. :thumbsup:
